question: In a two compartment distribution model, what do the following volumes represent: volume of distribution in stationary equilibrium state, extrapolated volume and beta volume or area volume ?:

options.opa: They are apparent volumes of total distribution.
options.opb: The physiological volume in which the drug is distributed.
options.opc: The total volume of water in the body in which the drug dissolves.
options.opd: The volume of the peripheral compartment.

analysis: In a two compartment distribution model, the volume of distribution in stationary equilibrium state represents the apparent volume of total distribution. The extrapolated volume represents the physiological volume in which the drug is distributed. The beta volume or area volume represents the volume of the peripheral compartment.
